description: This file defines the FxGraphDrawer class, which visualizes torch.fx.Graph objects using graphviz via pydot. It includes methods for generating and customizing graph visualizations, handling node styles, labels, and stack traces, and managing external dependencies like pydot.

classes.name: FxGraphDrawer
classes.description: A class for visualizing torch.fx.Graph objects as graphviz diagrams, with customizable node styles, labels, and support for stack trace annotations.

methods.name: get_dot_graph
methods.description: Returns a pydot.Dot object representing the graph, optionally for a submodule.

methods.name: get_main_dot_graph
methods.description: Returns the main graphviz Dot object for the primary graph.

methods.name: get_submod_dot_graph
methods.description: Returns the graphviz Dot object for a specified submodule.

methods.name: get_all_dot_graphs
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all generated graphviz Dot objects.

methods.name: _get_node_style
methods.description: Determines the style (shape, color, etc.) for a given node based on its operation type.

methods.name: _get_leaf_node
methods.description: Retrieves the leaf module or object targeted by a node, following attribute chains.

methods.name: _typename
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a target, escaping special characters.

methods.name: _shorten_file_name
methods.description: Shortens a full file path to the last N components for labeling.

methods.name: _get_node_label
methods.description: Generates a label string for a node, including its name, operation, target, args, kwargs, and metadata.

methods.name: _tensor_meta_to_label
methods.description: Converts tensor metadata into a string label.

methods.name: _stringify_tensor_meta
methods.description: Serializes TensorMetadata into a string for labeling.

methods.name: _get_tensor_label
methods.description: Creates a string label for a tensor.

methods.name: _to_dot
methods.description: Generates a graphviz Dot object representing the fx.GraphModule, with nodes and edges.
